source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 25 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Celestin»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Κελεστίνος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar keeps «Sfântul Mucenic Celestin» on, with the same bare personal name and the same rank word — the Trofim ground, a bare line on one calendar and a named entry on the same menologion day of another. The Greek adds the one fact either source gives about how he died: «τον θανάτωσαν με πυρακτωμένο σίδερο», they put him to death with red-hot iron, which the synaxarion couplet turns into the heel pierced with irons, «Πτέρνας σιδήροις εμπαρείς Kελεστίνος, Tον πτερνοτήρην συντρίβει πατών όφιν». **No `dates` object is proposed**: the page gives no year and no emperor at all, and its opening clause — that he belonged «στην ηρωική φάλαγγα της σταυρικής πορείας του Ιησού προς τον Γολγοθά», the heroic phalanx of Jesus's way of the Cross to Golgotha — is the site's rhetoric and not a date. The page also commemorates «Άγιος Παγχάριος» with him, on a page of his own that says nothing about him; Pancharius is a new folder in `el-05-25`. No hymn is printed for Celestine.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
